create_dataset_hparams: create a DatasetHparams dataclass to configure dataset name, batch size, and augmentation settings
create_model_hparams: create a ModelHparams dataclass to configure model name, initialization, and weight freezing options
create_training_hparams: create a TrainingHparams dataclass to configure optimizer, learning rate, and training steps
add_args_to_parser: add hyperparameter arguments from an Hparams subclass to an argparse parser with groups and defaults
create_hparams_from_args: create an Hparams instance from parsed argparse arguments using the create_from_args class method
